notes.raw:
\*Data above 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 582 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Ba; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0$ kcal/mol. 768 K, $\beta - \gamma$ transition point of Ba; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0$ kcal/mol. 1002 K, melting point of Ba; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.852$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{0} = 11.936 + 1.870 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.616 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0} - H_{298}^{0} = 11.936 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.935 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 0.616 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 3.848$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-582 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -131.563 + 17.487 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 17.475 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 520.950 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -131.563 - 17.487 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 17.475 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 260.475 \text{T}^{-1} + 133.068 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
582-768 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -128.042 + 5.247 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 4.335 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 27.450 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -128.042 - 5.247 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 4.335 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 13.725 \text{T}^{-1} + 57.469 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
768-1002 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -125.086 - 2.895 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 1.256 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 27.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -125.086 + 2.895 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 1.256 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 13.525 \text{T}^{-1} + 3.821 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1002-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -132.340 + 1.172 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.126 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 2493.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -132.340 - 1.172 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.126 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 1246.675 \text{T}^{-1} + 36.802 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Source: Data from Chase (17) who estimated those above 298 K.
